odoo.task: sign in to an empty workspace
odoo.notes: Not re-run live this round (demo not up before cutoff). Committed Odoo baseline gauntlet/reference/odoo/tasks/sign-in.json = 4 steps / 57 keystrokes / 19.06 modelled human seconds. The p00 compared task is sign-in to an EMPTY workspace, i.e. a first-time sign-in with no remembered e-mail, so our returning-user optimisation does not apply and the shortest path is identical: e-mail, Tab, password, Enter (4/57/19.06). Steps, keystrokes and modelled human time tie; ours wins only machine seconds. Per the owner's bar a tie is a loss. This matches the r3/r4 critics' own caveat that on a new device ours ties Odoo on 4/57/19.06.

biggest_gap.title: Sign-in to an empty workspace ties Odoo (steps, keystrokes, modelled human time); a tie is a loss
biggest_gap.detail: The only task p00 is compared on is 'sign in to an empty workspace'. Our sign-in screen only beats Odoo when it remembers the e-mail and focuses the password field (the returning-user path). An empty/first-time workspace has no remembered e-mail, so both products need the identical shortest expert path: type e-mail, Tab, type password, Enter. That is 4 steps, 57 keystrokes and 19.06 modelled human seconds in each product, so the task ties on every human-facing metric and ours wins only machine seconds, which the owner's bar does not count as a win ('a tie is a loss'). To actually beat Odoo on the empty-workspace sign-in, reduce the human path itself for a first visit (for example: a single combined credential submit, passkey/WebAuthn as the default, a magic-link or one-tap that removes the password field, or autofocus plus Enter-to-submit from the e-mail field that skips the Tab) rather than relying on a remembered e-mail that does not exist on an empty workspace.
biggest_gap.evidence: Committed Odoo baseline: gauntlet/reference/odoo/tasks/sign-in.json -> counts.steps=4, keystrokes=57, human_seconds=19.06. Our fresh-device path is documented at 4/57/19.06 by the r3 and r4 verdicts (gauntlet/verdicts/p00-foundation--r003/r004). Reproduce: node gauntlet/compare/run.mjs --task sign-in --product both --out <out> against a freshly seeded ./erp up (never previously signed in on that browser profile) and the odoo-reference rig; compare steps/keystrokes/klm human seconds.
